Direct BFS, exhaustive enumeration and definition checks for fourteen small cases returned VERIFY_OK; all-parameter correctness rests on the proof.

Prior 2013 product and 2020 strong-resolving-graph theorems provide dimension reduction, while 2023 independence homotopy and 2026 rotation-character results do not imply this optimum reconfiguration geometry. Searches of published-finding corpus and existing own claims gave no covering result; all priority judgments remain provisional.

value.rationale: A complete two-parameter classification of labelled minimum strong metric sensor bases and the exact family of optimum exchange graphs yields sharp parity-dependent, block-dependent phase transitions and a uniform slide obstruction. These refine known minimum cardinalities to nontrivial geometry of feasible optimum relocation. The exceptional K_{3,3} reconfiguration threshold is a natural boundary, not arbitrary parameter selection.
